1.title: Welcome to Smart Governance
1.subtitle: 2026 Digital Public Infrastructure Gateway
1.desc: Your unified portal to access municipal services, submit civic complaints, track SLA timelines, and claim welfare benefits 100% paperless.

2.title: Start Your Citizen Journey
2.subtitle: Account & Single Sign-On Access
2.desc: Create your citizen account to access digital services, submit complaints, track requests, and manage your applications. Already registered? Sign in to continue.

3.title: Report Civic Issues
3.subtitle: Direct Municipal Department Dispatch
3.desc: Report problems such as water leaks, road damage, street-light failures, power outages, sanitation issues, and other civic concerns directly through the platform.

4.title: Apply for Certificates Online
4.subtitle: Instant e-Services
4.desc: Apply for services such as Birth, Income, Residence, and other eligible certificates digitally without unnecessary office visits.

5.title: Access Welfare Services
5.subtitle: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)
5.desc: Explore eligible welfare schemes, pensions, scholarships, and other support services available through the digital platform.

6.title: Track Your Complaint
6.subtitle: Transparent Resolution Timeline
6.desc: Once you submit a complaint, you can follow its progress, see its current status, view the assigned department or officer, and monitor the expected resolution timeline.

7.title: Centralized Municipal Catalog
7.subtitle: Explore All Services
7.desc: Find municipal services in one place. Search or browse services by category such as Grievances, Certificates, Permits, and Welfare.

8.title: Official Bulletins & Alerts
8.subtitle: Real-Time City Broadcasts
8.desc: Stay informed about emergency advisories, water supply schedules, road closures, and municipal announcements affecting your ward.

9.title: Need Help?
9.subtitle: Restart Tour & Help Resources
9.desc: You can restart this guided tour whenever you need help understanding the platform. If an AI Assistant is available, you can also use it to ask questions about available services and navigation.
